text: Eight-year-old Peter, shy and bullied, lives with his overbearing parents Carol and Mark, who forbid him to go trick-or-treating because a girl vanished from the neighbourhood years ago. At night he hears [tapping from inside his bedroom wall|images|sounds, smells and silence], and soon a girl's voice speaks to him, saying [his parents locked her away|wrong|harm done to children] and calling them evil. His parents insist he is imagining it, while the voice urges him on and [something lies buried in the garden|images|corpses and body parts].
